S1.name: Shipment 1
S1.lede: The dedicated-box letter: one R640, one Ubuntu guest, no RayNu-V engineer in the room.

Final.name: Final SKU
Final.lede: Everything a professional operator expects from a PowerEdge hypervisor, through cluster and VMware migration. If it is not a row here, it is not the product.

items.note: Iron `621654369b68` / run `40958321431`. `boot: B4 acpi rsdp gpa=0x804000 (power button and PCI0 IRQ 11; no MADT)`. Shut down: `boot: B4 sci`, `systemd-poweroff.service`, `reboot: Power down`, `boot: B4 power off`; the guest stayed down. Reboot on a later F11 of the same stick: `boot: B4 sci`, `reboot: Power down`, `boot: B4 power cycle`, `guest reset requested src=acpi n=1`, then `raynusrv2 login:` again. Stop was not the path. `84ad5422` had no `PCI0` and the initrd never saw `vda`. Evidence `docs/evidence/r640/2026-10-29-62165436-wave-4-b4-power-ok.md`. Wave 4 stays open on D9

items.capability: Guests autostart at host boot, in operator order, with a delay
items.note: Iron `e6ed42a31ba4` / run `40938025112`. Boot next wrote `boot: B5 autostart wr lba=6190268909 match`. The next F11, with the SPA never opened, printed `boot: B5 autostart rd lba=6190268909 n=1` and `boot: B5 autostart start off=19327352832`, then the tail boot and `raynusrv2 login:`. Same boot kept the NIC catalog (`n=1`), the audit chain (`n=32`), and `boot: C7 virtio flush sync status=0x00`. That COM2 PCI probe had virtio-blk `00:02.0` and no virtio-net `00:05.0`; `systemd-networkd-wait-online` failed because this start did not call `on_accepted_start`. The branch now does, and prints `boot: B5 autostart nic` or `nic none`. That line is not on this COM2. Evidence `docs/evidence/r640/2026-10-29-e6ed42a3-wave-4-b5-autostart-ok.md`. Wave 4 stays open on B4

items.capability: Audit survives host reboot (persisted, chained across boots)
items.note: Iron `33488fb7` / run `40923163642`. Sixteen sectors at LBA `6190268910`, immediately before the NIC catalog. Boot 1: `boot: audit chain rd none`, then `boot: audit chain wr lba=6190268910 match`. Boot 2, same stick, no reflash: `boot: audit chain rd lba=6190268910 n=9`. That line prints only after `adopt_image` verifies the spare chain from genesis and appends this boot's `BootStarted` and `OvmfLiveEspBytesRetained`. Payloads stay out of the hash. Evidence `docs/evidence/r640/2026-10-29-33488fb7-wave-3-g4-audit-chain-reboot-ok.md`. `0421c2fd` never printed `wr`
